title.zh: 黑森林FLUX 3 Klein开源：官方自测超Qwen，玩家却嫌不如旧版4B
title.en: 黑森林FLUX 3 Klein开源：官方自测超Qwen，玩家却嫌不如旧版4B

current_state.zh: Black Forest Labs released the open-weights FLUX 3 Image Klein image model, which tops Qwen-Image 2.1 on internal benchmarks but drew lukewarm community and third-party test results, especially on pose editing and multi-image composition.
